note: HELD, NOT APPLIED. Proposed attachment corrections from the 22 Sep 2026 cross-check of the second tranche that no named source was checked against. NOTHING READS THIS FILE: generateLigamentSeed.ts reads ligament-attachment-corrections.json only, so every ligament here keeps its derived attachments and stays needsReview — which means the app asks it by picture and name and never grades its attachments (reviewedAttachmentIds, types/structure.ts). The reason this file exists is row n=92: a confident correction to the dorsal scaphotriquetral ligament was checked and turned out to be wrong, and the same reasoning produced several rows below.
promoteWith: Move the row into ligament-attachment-corrections.json with attachmentStructureIds, description, confirmed: true, grade: "verified" and a sources array, then rerun: npx tsx src/scripts/generateLigamentSeed.ts --min-visible 0 --traced

rows.why: Bony attachment is the anterior and posterior horns on the tibial intercondylar area. The femoral relationship is articular; the meniscofemoral ligaments are separate named structures.
rows.reviewNote: Standard teaching, but not source-checked. Confirm before shipping.

rows.why: Lateral talar process to the lateral calcaneus, deep to the calcaneofibular ligament. The render shows the mesh reaching the calcaneus.
rows.reviewNote: The name itself carries the answer, so risk is low, but not source-checked.

rows.why: Medial limb of the bifurcate ligament. The calcaneocuboid limb is a separate structure.
Arises from the apex of the fibular head and arches over popliteus into the posterior capsule.

Consider ADDING the trapezoid: the AAHS cadaveric study found a consistent trapezoid insertion of 56.9 ± 27.0 mm², and the AJR review notes a dorsal proximal trapezium attachment in about half of individuals.
